statistical_policy.hm: For each dataset/method/seed compute 2*Base*Novel/(Base+Novel); then mean and sample SD over seeds 1,2,3.
statistical_policy.differences: Subtract route-specific reference at matching dataset and seed before averaging; unit is percentage points (pp).
statistical_policy.macro: Equal weight to all ten datasets. Mean equals average of dataset three-seed means; macro sample SD is over three per-seed ten-dataset macro values, NOT pooled 30 records or dataset SD.
statistical_policy.positive: Strict >0 on unrounded values; exact zero is not positive. Seed counts are descriptive, not significance tests.
statistical_policy.dual_positive: Dataset: mean main-R1 >0 AND mean main-R0 >0. Seed: both differences >0 at the same seed.
statistical_policy.uncertainty: Sample SD (ddof=1), not a confidence interval. Three seeds do not establish statistical significance or guaranteed improvement.
statistical_policy.arithmetic: Mean and sample variance are computed with exact Fraction ratios of the input binary floats. Mean is converted once to float; SD is math.sqrt(float(exact sample variance)). No decimal rounding of stored metrics; this fixes Python statistics.stdev version-dependent last-bit differences.

harp.recorded_policy: seed1/2@18645; seed3@26006; EuroSAT seed2 paired replay selected
harp.selected: records: existing result-selected EuroSAT seed2 pair is retained; not relabeled as first runs.
harp.original: Only the two explicit original_eurosat_seed2 HARP/R1 records replace their selected counterparts; all other main records unchanged.

revision_selections.reason: User-directed post-result revision; original not invalidated
User-directed post-result revision; original not invalidated

larp.r1: Each LARP variant is compared with LARP's R1 at the same dataset and seed; not HARP's R1.
larp.r0_identity: R0 external frozen KD reference, not contemporaneous same-machine control
larp.r0_note: External reference numbers reused; no new evaluation or same-level re-audit claimed.
larp.replays: The separate Pets diagnostic replay is not an extra seed and is not substituted into flat_results.
larp.ablation_limits: Rank/scale and layer/capacity coupling and cross-machine reference reuse are not pure causal contrasts.

source_policy.cross_route: HARP and LARP are independent methods with route-specific controls. Do not rank methods across routes from equal-looking reference numbers or unmatched environments.
source_policy.scope: Recalculation of lightweight historical records only; no training, new evaluation, new result selection or full checkpoint/log audit. No per-epoch Novel values inferred.
